Class Manager

project.models.actors.User
project.models.actors.Employee
project.models.actors.Manager
All Implemented Interfaces:

public class Manager extends Employee
University manager. Handles course registrations, teacher assignments, news, and researcher-role approvals. Type (OR or DEPARTMENTS) determines area of responsibility.
